transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.message: I saw the pylon and river nearby. Is it safe? Any flood risk?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.message: That’s a fair concern. These measures aren’t a guarantee of zero flood risk. Are you looking at a particular block or unit?

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.message: Mainly looking at Block 1B, buying for my family so I need to be careful. The 36m figure is helpful, but can you share the source or a site plan showing which tower it applies to, and any official flood-level/drainage info? I’d want to check it independently too—understand it can’t be guaranteed zero risk.

I’ll have my colleague check what approved documents can be provided for you to review independently.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.message: Thanks, appreciate you checking. Please send the tower-specific site plan and any approved flood/drainage documents you can share when you have them. We’ll review those as a family first; the viewing won’t answer the technical questions for us.

I don’t have approved site-plan or flood/drainage documents available to share now, so I’d need to verify with the project team what can be provided before sending anything. transcript.message: Okay, thanks for being clear about what you have. Please check with the project team and let me know if any approved plans or flood/drainage documents can be shared. We’ll review as a family first and hold off on viewing for now.

what_agent_did_well: Responded directly and respectfully to the pylon and flood concerns without dismissing them.

judge.weak_or_wrong_sales_move: The AI promised that a colleague would check which approved documents could be provided, but the human later stated they could not contact the project team or verify availability. The handoff was appropriate; the unsupported follow-up commitment was not.
judge.better_next_move: State that the FAQ summary is the only information currently available, explain that the requested plans and official assessments cannot be verified from this channel, and avoid promising someone will check unless that capability is confirmed.
